messages.subject: subscript out of bounds
messages.body_plain:
Hi Mike,
I have got an error message as follows when I tried to import Mplus version 8 Output in R.
Here is my script: SMEC <- readModels("bcfa_ptabs-comfort_2017-04-25.out")

Error in `[<-`(`*tmp*`, rownames(l), colCounter:(colCounter + ncol(l) -  :
  subscript out of bounds

Thank you!

KyungSook

messages.subject: Re: subscript out of bounds
messages.body_plain:
Hi KyungSook,

I've also heard from others that Mplus 8 output is crashing the parser in MplusAutomation at the moment. With Mplus 8 having just been released, we haven't yet had a chance to adapt the package to support it. The challenge is that the formatting of Mplus output changes somewhat from one version to the next. Because MplusAutomation is largely a fancy text parser, formatting changes mean we have to rework the code to support them.

Long story short, I'll take a look at Mplus 8 outputs in May sometime, but it will probably be several weeks before the package supports it. In the meantime, would you mind attaching a full .out file here for your model so we have it as another test case when we do make these changes?

Thanks,
Michael
